finding: Random() % 1027 maps the 65536 possible draws unevenly: 835 dex entries have 64 preimages and 192 have 63.
fix: Reject draws at or above 64701 before modulo, retaining the 20-attempt safety bound and existing species validation/fallback.
coverage: All 65536 initial draws; each of 1027 dex entries has exactly 63 accepted preimages. Rejected suffix retries without dex lookup. NONE, EGG, out-of-range and zero-HP mapping exhaust twenty attempts without unsafe base-stat access; twenty rejected random draws also terminate with the existing Pikachu fallback.
limitations: Controlled mapping and base-stat fixtures. Actual DPE dex mapping, PRNG sequence, whole generated-mon fields and game runtime remain unverified. Bounded failure fallback still has a tiny Pikachu bias, and invalid dex mappings affect the reachable species distribution.
